summary: This is the Shop family — 33 members: Maker (the foreman/hub, 44 inbound), Shopkeeper (the scout), and 31 Specialists across sound/image/motion/interactive/perception, plus two infrastructure entries (RunPod GPU Backend as substrate, OBS as an operated-not-dispatched tool that openly breaks the Specialist model). The anatomy is remarkably uniform — every Specialist repeats Charter/Voice/Capabilities/Tiers/Job Contract/Self-Check/Resource-Footprint/Gotchas/Recipes — and that uniformity is deliberate house style, not sprawl; Loudon's "cluttered" feeling, if it lives here, is in the drift between the Maker's hand-written prose (Selection Heuristics, Host Capability Check, "Still stub" list) and the roster's actual growth, not in redundant entries. Two real gaps stood out: (1) five newer perception/decomposition/rig Specialists (Depth Anything, LaMa, SAM, Figure Rig, Lettering) — all born from BLUELINE's line-art work and wired tightly to each other — have no Selection Heuristic entry in Maker at all, so the front door doesn't know they exist; (2) three Specialists that generate their own visual surface (Matplotlib, Mermaid, LaTeX) each carry the identical unresolved open question — "we need a house-defaults wrapper like palace-plot-defaults.js" — while their siblings (D3, Plot, p5, Three.js) already solved it; this is the same problem solved three times over and still open three times. The Maker's own hand-maintained "Still stub" list is already stale (missing Image-to-3D Smith), which is the exact rot pattern the roster table was restructured to prevent — the prose annotations are a second, undefended copy. Two entries have live stale content: Three.js's Forward Vector still narrates itself as pre-alive despite being promoted by the Wavetable Scanner job, and Shopkeeper's "Pending Commission" for an Image-to-3D deposit is already fulfilled (the entry exists) but not marked closed. No genuine merge or compost candidates surfaced — Midjourney's deprecated-but-kept status is deliberate lineage, not clutter, and the stub Specialists (LaTeX, RNBO codebox~ smith, Image-to-3D Smith) are real anatomy awaiting a first job, not misfiled working substrate.

coherence_findings.issue: Five Specialists born from BLUELINE's line-art work (Depth Anything, LaMa, SAM, Figure Rig, Lettering) are tightly wired to each other and to BLUELINE but have no entry in Maker's Selection Heuristics section — the front-door dispatcher's 'house taste, codified' list has zero mention of when to route a brief to layer decomposition, inpainting, segmentation, figure rigging, or emotional lettering.
coherence_findings.proposed_action: Add a Selection Heuristic block to Maker naming the perception/decomposition family (Depth Anything → order/silhouette, SAM → object cut given a converted domain, LaMa → hole-fill, Figure Rig → pose+body→ControlNet plates, Lettering → emotional letterform) so the roster growth since 2026-06 is legible from the front door.

coherence_findings.issue: Matplotlib, Mermaid, and LaTeX each independently carry the same unresolved open question — a house-defaults wrapper analogous to palace-tokens.js / palace-plot-defaults.js so the Loudon Live design-system tokens reach the tool's own generated typography/palette. D3.js and p5.js solved this as an additive pattern; Observable Plot solved it as a subtractive wrapper (palacePlot()). Three siblings are each waiting on the same unbuilt piece of plumbing.
coherence_findings.proposed_action: Build one shared wrapper pattern once (following palace-plot-defaults.js as the template for 'tool generates its own surface'), then point Matplotlib/Mermaid/LaTeX at it, closing three duplicated open questions with one piece of work.

coherence_findings.issue: Maker's Host Capability Check (Shop/Maker/host-capability.json) and its Fallback table were last dated 2026-05-30; nine Specialists born since (Blender, Depth Anything, LaMa, SAM, Figure Rig, Lettering, Hero and Avatar Maker, Image-to-3D Smith, OBS) are absent from the fallback table, so the dispatch-time reachability check Maker's own Charter promises ('I check reachability before I waste the intake') silently can't cover roughly a third of the current roster.
coherence_findings.proposed_action: Refresh host-capability.json and the Fallback table alongside the next roster-touching Weave; flag any of the nine as GPU/host-bound-only (no fallback) explicitly rather than leaving them unlisted.

coherence_findings.issue: Maker's 'Still stub' hand-written sentence in the Promotion Log ('RNBO codebox~ smith; LaTeX') omits Image-to-3D Smith, which is also status: stub. This is the exact three-place-drift pattern the roster table was restructured (2026-06-16) to eliminate structurally — but the prose annotation beside the generated table is a second, still-hand-maintained copy that has already drifted once.
coherence_findings.proposed_action: Either fold the stub/deprecated call-outs fully into the generated table (derived from frontmatter status, same as the roster itself) or accept the prose is decorative-only and stop treating it as authoritative.

open_question_resolutions.question: Training a Loudon Live LoRA on a small reference set — when does this become worth the effort?
open_question_resolutions.proposed_action: Note in ComfyUI's Open Questions that LoRA Trainer answered this operationally: the lever is dataset quality (visible faces, varied light/angle), not step count — and the DreamBooth-control move is the honest way to separate a bad pipeline from a bad dataset.

open_question_resolutions.question: House defaults for color palette in Manim — declare project-level constants or inject per-scene?
open_question_resolutions.proposed_action: Manim CE's own Study/Piece recipes already resolve palette through Loudon Live Design System tokens (Graphite skin, hex pairs named inline) — not a dedicated wrapper script like Plot's, but a working convention. Mark progressed, not fully closed until a token-reading helper exists.

open_question_resolutions.question: The AudioWorklet↔render-loop handoff shape — SharedArrayBuffer vs postMessage snapshots — 'first answered by the Waveguide job.'
open_question_resolutions.proposed_action: The Wavetable Scanner recipe already exercises this exact seam (worklet owns process(), visualizer reads the same Float32Array) ahead of the still-unbuilt Waveguide Synthesizer job. Three.js's own forward_vector hasn't been updated to reflect this — see entry_health_flags.

open_question_resolutions.question: Do I have authority to deposit a new Specialist stub myself once trusted, or does every Roster addition stay a Loudon decision forever?
open_question_resolutions.proposed_action: Image-to-3D Smith's own header records the de facto answer already in practice: 'entry written by Shopkeeper from calibration probe; not yet dispatched — Loudon's approval needed before promoting to alive.' So Shopkeeper can draft a stub; promotion to alive still needs Loudon. Worth writing that precedent back into Shopkeeper's Open Questions explicitly rather than leaving it open.

open_question_resolutions.question: Does Kokoro pronounce 'RNBO' as 'rin-bo' or letter-by-letter?
open_question_resolutions.proposed_action: Genuinely blocked on RNBO codebox~ smith remaining a stub with no first job — nothing in the family answers this yet.

open_question_resolutions.question: House-defaults wrapper for the tool's own generated typography/palette.
open_question_resolutions.proposed_action: See coherence_findings — same unresolved question in three entries, none answered by a sibling despite the pattern existing (Observable Plot's palacePlot()).

open_question_resolutions.question: Audition automation — a headless Rack render path to close the loop on Piece-tier audio capture.
open_question_resolutions.proposed_action: No sibling addresses Rack automation; stays a genuine gap, noted as the entry's own standing seam.

entry_health_flags.vector_issue: Forward Vector section still narrates the Waveguide Synthesizer Sketch as the job that 'moves this entry stub → alive' — but the entry was already promoted to alive by the Wavetable Scanner recipe (2026-05-31), which is documented two sections earlier in the same file. The Forward Vector wasn't updated after the promotion it describes.
entry_health_flags.graffiti_note: Flag only — do not rewrite. The Forward Vector reads as if written before the promotion it's adjacent to.

entry_health_flags.vector_issue: The 'Pending Commission' section ('Approved 2026-06-08 — execute next scheduled run... Deposit an Image-to-3D smith Specialist') is stale: Image-to-3D Smith now exists as a stub entry. The commission was executed but the section still reads as an open directive.
entry_health_flags.graffiti_note: Should be marked fulfilled/closed rather than left as a standing instruction that already happened.
